name: Sessions View
description: VS Code WebviewView sidebar panel that lists open and saved Claude/shell sessions for the active worktree. Shows live activity indicators (blink), session icons, and exposes rename/close/set-icon context menu actions. Rows also show hook-reported live state (running · <tool> / waiting / idle) from SessionManager.getLiveState, a bound-task chip (click → codeWorkbench.tasks.openTaskInPage) from SavedSession.boundTask, and a compact token count (tooltip = breakdown) from SessionManager.getUsage. Live state comes from cw-hook.mjs posting {type:'activity'} lines to the NotifyServer (onActivity); it is in-memory only and coalesced (250ms) before refreshing. Token usage is summed from the Claude transcript JSONL (sessionLaunch.readSessionUsage, cached by mtime+size, last entry per message id wins); getTaskUsage aggregates over all sessions bound to a task and feeds the TaskDetailPane usage line via the codeWorkbench.tasks.usage command.
guidelines: Subscribe to both onDidChange (structural changes) and onBlink (activity flicker) to avoid refreshing idle rows unnecessarily.
Session icon codicons are configurable per-session and persisted; new icon takes effect on next terminal open since VS Code has no live iconPath setter.
Live hook state is in-memory only so a stale 'running' never survives a host restart; only trust it for open sessions.
anti_patterns: Do not trigger a full tree refresh on every blink tick — only refresh active session rows to avoid idle-row flicker.
Do not refresh the view on every raw activity event — coalesce them.
decisions: Uses retainContextWhenHidden to preserve webview state across panel collapse.
Activity is a separate notify message type ('activity'), not a notification kind, so it never raises a toast.
